description: Voltage, current and power readings and current alerts

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: The measured channel, counted from 0 (the INA3221's channel 1 is 0; the AP33772S has 0 only; the DRV8962's follow its topology)

fields.description: The measured channel, counted from 0 (the INA3221's channel 1 is 0; the AP33772S has 0 only; the DRV8962's follow its topology)

commands.label: Current alert
commands.description: Arms a hardware alert that publishes an event when the current crosses a threshold.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: The measured channel, counted from 0 (the INA3221's channel 1 is 0; the AP33772S has 0 only; the DRV8962's follow its topology)

fields.label: Threshold
